Name: The Blue Interface
Author: TheWolfInBlue
Description:
I saw the pink interface mod and fell in love with the idea, but personally i've never been a big fan of pink
so with permission I made my own version and i'm really happy with the outcome!

Let me know if there's any mods you'd like me to add or make compatible with this
or if you'd just like me to post the PNG files so you can use it yourself!

After you unzip the file, open your stardew valley folder, located:

Computer > C: > Program Files > Steam > SteamApps > Common > Stardew Valley

[list]
[*]Open the Content folder
[*]Drag and drop everything into the Content folder
[*]Allow all the folders to merge
[*]Allow all the files to overwrite the old ones
[/list]
[center][b]WARNING!!
Do not use any mods with this that overlap any of the following files! It will mess it up completely!
'Farmhouse_Tiles.xnb'  'TownInterior.xnb'  'Cursors.xnb'  'Textbox.xnb'  'Font_Bold.xnb' 'MenuTiles.xnb'
[/b][/center]
Use SMAPI for best results

This will work with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/299/]Bathroom after 2nd Houseupgrade by [b]DevilBro[/b][/url]
[size=1]
Future Edits:
- Figure out how to change the colour for your money in the upper right hand - from red to white
- [s]Figure out how to make the toolbar blue
[/s]- [s]Figure out how to make your menu blue[/s][/size]

Keep in mind i've not really modded ever, so
Let me know if you find any bugs!
